$comment: Visual subjects for the 80 ability icons, keyed by manifest id (ability_<fighter>_<ability>): what the icon SHOWS (the fighter's prop, gesture or effect at its moment), not what the ability does (that is the kit text in content/fighters/<fighter>.json). build_ability_prompts.py turns these into manifest prompts. Rules: no faces (props, hands and effects; a masked figure at most); each fighter's five icons use a different dominant shape; the FighterDef.palette hexes named in plain colour words; Lumen effects are light and glass shards, Shade effects are ink smoke with a bright rim; materials of the Vale only (stone, glass, carved wood, cloth, felt, leather, resin, ironstone); no gold, gems, runes, gears or polished metal; no digits.
